_note: W-184: every MODELLED row's listing of a rule that does not itself name the row's section. Each entry keeps the pairing and states, in one sentence, the claim that justifies it; a listing that could not state its claim was removed instead. The check compares this list as an exact set, so it may only shrink: a new mismatch fails, and so does an entry that no longer mismatches.
